summary: Evaluates existing configured models against a bounded specialization contract and proposes a Bifrost tier without changing configuration.

outer.initialMessage: Start Model Foundry. Requested specialization preset: {{specialization}}.

inputs.prompt: What work should this model pool optimize for

requires.bifrost: Installed and configured in target project
manualAssumptions: Candidate evaluation makes provider calls only after user consent.
Proposal requires explicit user approval before any config edit.

acceptance: Only models already configured in project Bifrost config are evaluated.
Each candidate runs explicit read-only tasks with explicit model selection.
Proposal reports evidence, uncertainty, reliability, cost/latency when observed, and no universal capability claim.
Project Bifrost config remains unchanged without explicit user approval.
